dcat_keyword_sm: other languages used regularly at work
dct_description_sm: Statistics Canada Census Data from 2021. This dataset includes the other languages used regularly at work data provided by Statistics Canada joined with the census tracts. Each topic covered by the census was exported as a separate table. Each table contains the total, male, and female characteristics as fields for each census tract. Topics range from population, age and sex, immigration, language, family and households, income, education, and labour. For more information on definitions of terms used in the tables and other notes, refer to Statistics Canada's 2021 Census.
dct_title_s: 2021 Other Languages Used Regularly at Work by Census Tract
